request.style: English, gospel, powerful female solo voice with backing choir, piano, organ, drum kit, bass guitar, uplifting mood, 100 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Owe no one anything, except to love one another
Whoever loves the other has fulfilled the law
The commandments are summed up in this simple word
Love your neighbor as yourself, that is the road

[Chorus]
The hour has already come for you to wake from sleep
Salvation is nearer to us now than when we first believed
The night is nearly over, the day is at hand
Let us cast off the works of darkness, put on the armor of light

[Verse]
Live decently, as in the daytime, not in carousing
Not in drunkenness, not in sexual immorality
Not in quarreling, not in jealousy or strife
Give no thought to gratifying the desires of the flesh

[Chorus]
The hour has already come for you to wake from sleep
Salvation is nearer to us now than when we first believed
The night is nearly over, the day is at hand
Let us cast off the works of darkness, put on the armor of light

[Bridge]
Clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus Christ
Wake from sleep, the time is near
The day is at hand, let us be ready
Cast off darkness, put on the light

[Chorus]
The hour has already come for you to wake from sleep
Salvation is nearer to us now than when we first believed
The night is nearly over, the day is at hand
Let us cast off the works of darkness, put on the armor of light

[Outro]
The day is at hand
Put on the armor of light
